S0a.name: evidence_infrastructure
rules_may_only: parse deterministic event and tool facts

S0b.causal_packet: direct T0-T5 sections; T0/T1 are not reconstructed from derived State Diff output
S0b.classification_bridge: a human causal YES plus two agreeing evidence-bound judges may write system Type A/B/C classification into re-hashed S0 evidence cards
engineering_consequence_sources: structured tool result with exit code
S0b.independent_second_judge: targeted review of every primary suspect and low-confidence case plus a reproducible Goal-root-stratified sample of healthy cases and no-post controls; target 30, normally 20-40, with mandatory-case overflow reported
S0b.name: semantic_grading
S0b.outcome_blinding: State Diff sees pre-state, compaction summary, and post-plan only.
S0b.checkpoint_provenance: scan, packet, model, effort, API base, timeout, prompt, schema, request/response IDs, and token usage
S0b.smoke_approval_binding: exact payload SHA-256 plus exact non-secret judge-configuration SHA-256
S0b.state_diff_isolation: one opportunity per API request; output schema binds the exact opportunity and allowed evidence IDs
S0b.judge_transport: direct OpenAI-compatible Responses API; no codex exec subprocess
S0b.judge_tool_policy: request and response both require tools=[]; store=false and parallel_tool_calls=false
S0b.maximum_judge_attempts_per_opportunity: 1 normally; up to two explicitly authorized retries only for an HTTP 504 with no request ID, response ID, or usage
S0b.dispatch_recovery: pre-POST durable tombstone; uncertain transport outcome forbids resend; a concrete HTTP 504 without provenance may receive at most two audited explicit retries

smoke_gate.scope: safety_and_evidence_binding_only; no accuracy or recall claim
smoke_gate.no_post_plan_controls: all must be UNASSESSABLE and not suspected

S0b.state_window: deterministic temporal coverage plus recency; not a last-N-only window
S0b.single_writer: one workspace semantic lock with atomic fsynced checkpoint replacement
